[http://www.netcommwireless.com/product/wifi/np920 Product page], [https://support.netcommwireless.com/sites/default/files/NP920-Spec-Sheet-white.pdf Datasheet] The Windows driver for this device has three device IDs specified... *0a5c:bd13 (default BCM4323 ID, probably) *0a5c:bd16 (appears to be 2.4GHz only) *0a5c:bd17 (default BCM43236 ID, probably) Netcomm indicates this device is using BCM43236 in their datasheet, therefore, it is assumed it is using the default BCM43236 USB ID. The revision (BCM43236 / BCM43236B) is not known. ==Images== File:NP920-hi-res-1.jpg|main, cap off File:NP920-hi-res-2.jpg|main, cap on [[Has images::external| ]]
